title: Form Retrieval at R2 and R3

lessons.title: Three fields return at R2
lessons.gloss: retrieve the three-field no-model task and its bounded repair passes at R2

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: No new labels or values appear. Keep every bank closed and recall the order language, residence, work.
Complete the three fields for cues B, A, B. Finish the whole attempt before checking anything.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — one bounded repair pass

segments.text: Compare selection, spelling, spacing, then placement. Repair only the first differing dimension. If the work row differs, repair that row only.
Stop after one form. This is retrieval, not a longer writing test.

segments.prompt: With every bank closed, complete language, residence, and work for cues B, A, B; then repair only the first differing dimension.
acceptedResponses: ਭਾਸ਼ਾ: ਹਿੰਦੀ ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼: ਪਿੰਡ ਕੰਮ: ਨੌਕਰੀ

feedback.correct: The no-model form returned and the repair stayed bounded.
feedback.incorrect: Check selection, spelling, spacing, then placement; stop after the first repair.

lessons.title: Rebuild one work row at R3
lessons.romanization: work field supported build at R3
lessons.gloss: rebuild the known job value and its work-field mapping at R3

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script and value recall until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Read the three labels in order: ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼, ਕੰਮ. Point to the work label and stop.
Trace ੌ once above ਨ, making ਨੌ. Then read the known value ਨੌਕਰੀ once.
Use the old bank once: A — ਖੇਤੀ and B — ਨੌਕਰੀ.
Choose B. Complete ਕੰਮ: __________. Keep the bank visible for this one attempt.
One supported row is enough. The next lesson removes the bank after a short delay.

segments.prompt: After naming the third field as work, use visible-bank cue B to complete ਕੰਮ: ______.

feedback.correct: Cue B rebuilt the known job value on the work field.
feedback.incorrect: Point to ਕੰਮ, find B — ਨੌਕਰੀ, and copy only that known value.

lessons.title: Hide, write, and check one work row at R3
lessons.romanization: work field delayed control at R3
lessons.gloss: retrieve one work value after a delay and check its four known controls at R3

needs: a pen and something to write on
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Read the old work bank A — ਖੇਤੀ, B — ਨੌਕਰੀ. Select B, hide the bank, and count slowly to ten.
With the bank hidden, complete ਕੰਮ: __________ for B.

blocks.title: Guided Practice — four checks, no rewrite

segments.text: Reveal the model. Check the value piece by piece, the one space after the colon, and that the job value stayed on the work field. Repair only the first difference.
Stop after one delayed row. This closes the bounded R3 retrieval pass without adding a new form field.

segments.prompt: Select B from the work bank, hide it for ten seconds, write the work row, then name the three checks.
acceptedResponses: ਕੰਮ: ਨੌਕਰੀ; spelling, spacing, field agreement

feedback.correct: The delayed value returned with all three controls intact.
feedback.incorrect: Repair in order: spelling, one space after the colon, then the matching work field.
